title: Architecture
subtitle: 建築設計、建築風格、結構設計、外觀語言——哪些說法最接近 architecture？
description: 建築設計、建築風格、結構設計、外觀語言——哪些說法最接近 architecture？

words.note: 和 architecture 最直接、最自然的近義表達之一。強調建築物如何被設計，包括外形、空間安排、功能與外觀。

exercises.original: The city's modern architecture is known for large windows and open interiors.
exercises.upgrade: The city's modern architecture is known for large windows and open interiors.

options.explanation: 直接描述建築如何設計。

exercises.original: Sustainable architecture is becoming more common in new schools.
exercises.upgrade: Sustainable architecture is becoming more common in new schools.

exercises.original: The architecture of the new library focuses on natural light.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture of the new library focuses on natural light.

words.note: 比 building design 稍正式、更專業，常見於建築、工程、規劃和設計語境。

exercises.original: The architecture combines concrete, timber, and glass.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture combines concrete, timber, and glass.

exercises.original: The museum's architecture was developed around a central courtyard.
exercises.upgrade: The museum's architecture was developed around a central courtyard.

exercises.original: The architect explained the architecture during the presentation.
exercises.upgrade: The architect explained the architecture during the presentation.

words.note: 表示建築在外觀、比例、裝飾、材料和形式上的風格特徵。和 architecture 在談某個時期、地區或流派時非常接近。

exercises.original: The town is famous for its Victorian architecture.
exercises.upgrade: The town is famous for its Victorian architecture.

exercises.original: The building reflects the architecture of the Art Deco period.
exercises.upgrade: The building reflects the architecture of the Art Deco period.

options.explanation: Art Deco 是典型建築風格。
也接近但不如 style 精確。

exercises.original: Traditional Japanese architecture influenced the hotel.
exercises.upgrade: Traditional Japanese architecture influenced the hotel.

words.note: 表示建築在結構安排、支撐方式和整體構造上的風格。比 architectural style 更強調結構層面。

exercises.original: The station's architecture is defined by exposed steel frames.
exercises.upgrade: The station's architecture is defined by exposed steel frames.

exercises.original: The bridge has a distinctive architecture based on repeated arches.
exercises.upgrade: The bridge has a distinctive architecture based on repeated arches.

exercises.original: The hall's architecture depends on a visible timber frame.
exercises.upgrade: The hall's architecture depends on a visible timber frame.

options.explanation: 也可但不如 structural 精確。

words.note: 比 architectural style 更日常、直接。適合一般描述不同類型建築的外觀和設計特色。

exercises.original: The neighbourhood contains several types of traditional architecture.
exercises.upgrade: The neighbourhood contains several types of traditional architecture.

exercises.original: The local architecture has changed as new materials became available.
exercises.upgrade: The local architecture has changed as new materials became available.

options.explanation: 一般描述地方建築風格。

exercises.original: This building uses an architecture common in coastal towns.
exercises.upgrade: This building uses an architecture common in coastal towns.

words.note: 表示建築整體的設計取向和視覺風格。範圍比 architectural style 稍廣，也可用於室內或產品設計。

exercises.original: The hotel's architecture is minimalist and understated.
exercises.upgrade: The hotel's architecture is minimalist and understated.

exercises.original: The restaurant's architecture combines industrial and rustic elements.
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant's architecture combines industrial and rustic elements.

exercises.original: The new offices follow a Scandinavian architecture.
exercises.upgrade: The new offices follow a Scandinavian architecture.

options.explanation: Scandinavian 作設計風格很自然。

words.note: 較專業，常見於城市規劃、建築和設計研究。表示建築物及空間在現實中呈現出的整體形態、體量和配置。

exercises.original: The architecture of the district is dense and compact.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture of the district is dense and compact.

exercises.original: Planning rules have strongly shaped the area's architecture.
exercises.upgrade: Planning rules have strongly shaped the area's architecture.

options.explanation: planning 規則與城市形態關係直接。

exercises.original: The city's architecture became taller and denser after the 1980s.
exercises.upgrade: The city's architecture became taller and denser after the 1980s.

options.explanation: taller / denser 是城市形態特徵。

words.note: 表示建築或構築物的支撐系統、承重方式和結構安排。和 architecture 有高度重疊，但更偏工程與結構安全。

exercises.original: The architecture allows the roof to span the hall without internal columns.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture allows the roof to span the hall without internal columns.

options.explanation: 承重和跨度是結構問題。

exercises.original: The stadium's architecture uses a lightweight cable system.
exercises.upgrade: The stadium's architecture uses a lightweight cable system.

exercises.original: Engineers modified the architecture to improve earthquake resistance.
exercises.upgrade: Engineers modified the architecture to improve earthquake resistance.

words.note: 表示建築的輪廓、體量、幾何形狀和空間形式。比 architecture 更集中在「形」。

exercises.original: The architecture of the chapel is defined by a simple triangular volume.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture of the chapel is defined by a simple triangular volume.

exercises.original: The building's architecture curves around the edge of the lake.
exercises.upgrade: The building's architecture curves around the edge of the lake.

exercises.original: The architecture was inspired by folded paper.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture was inspired by folded paper.

words.note: 表示一套重複出現的視覺和形式特徵，例如線條、材料、比例、顏色和細節。適合描述某建築師、品牌或建築群的共同風格。

exercises.original: The new wing follows the architecture of the original museum.
exercises.upgrade: The new wing follows the architecture of the original museum.

options.explanation: 表示延續相同視覺／形式語彙。

exercises.original: The architect uses the same architecture across several projects.
exercises.upgrade: The architect uses the same architecture across several projects.

options.explanation: 通常每棟 form 可能不同。

exercises.original: Curved walls and exposed concrete are central to the building's architecture.
exercises.upgrade: Curved walls and exposed concrete are central to the building's architecture.

options.explanation: 反覆視覺特徵構成設計語言。

words.meaning: 建築美學；建築外觀風格
words.note: 表示建築給人的整體視覺感受和美學特色。比 architecture 更偏向外觀、質感和美感。

exercises.original: The renovation preserved the original architecture while upgrading the interior.
exercises.upgrade: The renovation preserved the original architecture while upgrading the interior.

options.explanation: 重點是視覺美學被保留。

exercises.original: The architecture is clean, elegant, and restrained.
exercises.upgrade: The architecture is clean, elegant, and restrained.

exercises.original: The hotel combines a modern architecture with traditional materials.
exercises.upgrade: The hotel combines a modern architecture with traditional materials.

words.note: 表示建築整體給人的視覺性格、外觀特色或識別感。較常用於保育、設計評論和規劃語境。

exercises.original: The new development respects the architecture of the historic street.
exercises.upgrade: The new development respects the architecture of the historic street.

exercises.original: The façade contributes strongly to the building's architecture.
exercises.upgrade: The façade contributes strongly to the building's architecture.

exercises.original: The use of brick gives the neighbourhood a distinctive architecture.
exercises.upgrade: The use of brick gives the neighbourhood a distinctive architecture.

options.explanation: 材料塑造整體視覺特色。

falseSynonyms.zh: 建造不等於建築設計 Construction 是把建築實際建起來的過程；architecture 是設計、形式和風格。
工程不等於建築 工程重點在技術、結構、安全和系統；建築還包含空間、美學和設計。
結構不等於 architecture Structure 可以指建築本身或其支撐方式，但範圍和 architecture 不完全相同。
室內設計不等於整體建築 Interior design 只聚焦室內空間。
城市設計不等於單棟建築 Urban design 通常處理街道、公共空間、街區和城市尺度。
藍圖不等於 architecture Blueprint 是圖紙或技術圖，不是整體建築設計概念。
佈局不等於 architecture Layout 只描述空間或元素如何排列。
立面不等於整體建築 Façade 是建築的一個外立面部分。
